name: rosetta-function-definition
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

multiply(left: double, right: double) -> double => left * right

describe(value: double) is
    write_line("{value}")
si

write_line("{multiply(3.0, 4.0)}")

describe(multiply(2.5, 2.0))

let anonymous = (left: double, right: double) => left * right

write_line("{anonymous(1.5, 6.0)}")
fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

multiply(left: double, right: double) -> double => left * right

describe(value: double) is
    write_line("{value}")
si

write_line("{multiply(3.0, 4.0)}")

describe(multiply(2.5, 2.0))

let anonymous = (left: double, right: double) => left * right

write_line("{anonymous(1.5, 6.0)}")
